body.statement: If exact aggregate support equality is replaced by the standard bounded-range condition \(Y_a\in[\ell_a,u_a]\), every nonempty branch contributes its full attained interval regardless of \(\tau_{a,b}^r(P)\). If the score restrictions are also removed, the branch polytope is the full box and the resulting arm endpoints are the classical Manski worst-case bounds.
body.justification: The reduction verifies that the support filter, rather than bounded outcomes alone, causes branch pruning.
body.gap: This is a required sanity reduction, not a novelty claim.
body.consumer: Readers can distinguish the exact-support contribution from standard worst-case bounded-outcome identification.
